newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank to extend one bln yuan mortgage loans.
newsitem.headline: China bank to extend one bln yuan mortgage loans.

text.p: The state-run Agriculture Bank of China plans to extend mortgage loans totalling one billion yuan ($120 million) to home buyers this year, a bank official said on Wednesday.
"We opened the new business this year, mainly for buyers of apartments built with public housing funds," said a bank official.

Only people who keep their deposits with the bank and those who pay public housing funds -- funds into which most employers and employees pay a certain percentage of their salary each month -- would be allowed to apply for the mortgages, he said.
The mortgage loans would be for a maximum of 20 years, with the loan amount up to 70 percent of the total purchase cost, he said, but gave no further details.
China's central bank, the People's Bank of China, issued new rules in April to make the issue of mortgage loans easier for individuals.
